title.zh: 蒙特卡洛 · 撒豆子算 π
title.en: Monte Carlo · Counting π with Scattered Beans

desc.zh: 算不出来的问题，可以撒豆子撒出来：随机撒点落在圆内的比例就是面积比，π 自己浮出来。误差按 1/√N 收缩——想多准一位，点要多撒一百倍。
desc.en: Some problems you can't solve, you can scatter your way to: the fraction of random points landing in a circle is an area ratio, and π surfaces on its own. Error shrinks like 1/√N — one more digit costs a hundred times the points.
